feb02.title: 5 website mistakes that cost local businesses calls
feb02.text:
Most local websites don't lose calls because of bad design.
They lose them because of 5 small, fixable mistakes.

01 No clear headline
02 A hidden phone number
03 Stock photos only
04 Slow on phones
05 No proof

Each one has a simple fix, and they're all in the document above.

Which one does your site have? Tell me in the comments.

Tarahan Choob builds custom woodwork, and their customers read Persian. So the whole site reads right to left: layout, menus, forms and type, not just translated text.

A website should speak your customers' language, literally.

feb16.alt: Four-step guide to setting up a Google Business Profile, with website previews on a laptop and phone.
feb16.text:
The free tool most local businesses forget: your Google Business Profile.

Set it up in 4 steps:

01 Search your business on Google Maps and claim it
02 Add your hours, service area and phone
03 Upload 10 real photos of your work
04 Link it to your website, with matching name and address

It takes about an hour, and it's how many customers will find you first.

Save this for later. 📌

#LocalSEO #GoogleBusinessProfile #SmallBusiness #TorontoBusiness #Milink

feb23.title: Your homepage's first screen has one job
feb23.text:
Your homepage's first screen has one job: make the right person stay.

In a few seconds, a visitor should know:

✅ What you do, for whom, where
✅ One main button
✅ A real photo of your work
✅ Where you work
✅ A hint of proof

The full checklist is in the document above. Swipe through and check your own site.
